description: This file defines the JsonWebKey interface representing a JSON Web Key (JWK) with its properties such as type, algorithm, usage, id, modulus, and exponent. It also includes a nested static class JsonFields that specifies JSON field definitions for serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: JsonWebKey
classes.description: Interface for a JSON Web Key, providing methods to access key parameters such as type, algorithm, usage, id, modulus, and exponent.

classes.name: JsonWebKey.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class containing JSON field definitions for the properties of a JsonWebKey, such as key type, algorithm, usage, id, modulus, and exponent.

methods.name: getModulus
methods.description: Returns the modulus component of the key.

methods.name: getExponent
methods.description: Returns the exponent component of the key.
